Yes, that's exactly what I was hoping for. I typed WEEKEND in caps and it found the pasta bookmark even though that word is only in my private note — so search really is looking through my notes and the web addresses now, not just the title and description. That covers the thing I flagged last time.

And seeing the note and the address right on each card is helpful — it makes it obvious *why* something matched, which I appreciate. That amount of context feels right, not cluttered. Good to keep going.
